articles.title: Groundworks® Issues Historic Dividend to Nearly 5,000 Employee Owners, Marking a New Era of Workforce Investment
articles.mainIdea: Groundworks® Issues Historic Dividend to Nearly 5,000 Employee Owners, Marking a New Era of Workforce Investment
articles.summary: Business Wire: Groundworks® Issues Historic Dividend to Nearly 5,000 Employee Owners, Marking a New Era of Workforce Investment. VIRGINIA BEACH, Va., February 19, 2026--Groundworks® ("the Company"), North America’s leading and fastest-growing foundation and water management solutions company, announced today the distribution of its first-ever employee dividend. This historic milestone reflects the Company’s strong performance, disciplined growth, and continued investment in its workforce.
